notes.title: Please read: Final patch.
notes.content:
As mentioned in previous posts, Development of Rimward Basilisk has stopped. 
Please consider supporting it's successor - Black beacon Hill, a complete overhaul and upgrade of Rimwrad Basilisk made with some serious reflection and effort.

A good review helps out a ton!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2641070/Black_Beacon_Hill/

notes.title: If anyone's still watching, this is the end for Rimward Basilisk.
notes.content:
But, the completely rewritten and reworked replacement is here...
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2641070/Black_Beacon_Hill/?beta=0

notes.title: Part 4 release
notes.content:
- 3 new stages with new mechanics, soundtracks, characters, and a lot more story content!
Plus numerous updates to previous stages / story dialogue, and some small bugfixes.

Featuring the hardest stage of this game by far...
Part 4 will be the conclusion of Arc 1.

notes.title: Part 3 quick patch
notes.content: Bug fixes + 3-3 and 3-4 now slightly easier.

notes.title: Part 3 release + Par 1 major gutting and rework
notes.content:
Part 3: 4 more stages with more story content, unique soundtracks, and new mechanics.

Part 1: A new tutorial stage has been added, and the story has been overhauled. 1-3 has been slightly tweaked and is now 1-2. and 1-1, 1-2, 1-4 are removed - They weren't great and had to go. 
(for existing players, a code to unlock these stages will be posted to the discussion forums later)

Lots of small tweaks for part 2 as well.

This update was a lot of effort. Hope y'all enjoy!

notes.title: tiny quick patch!
notes.content: fixed typos and added very short "tutorial" for 1-1

notes.title: Small patch
notes.content: Tweaked the camera movement a bit!
